args.title: Fix row shape error by ignoring blank rows after last transaction
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parseStatement function should be changed to also ignore trailing blank rows that have columns but no data, after the last transaction. This prevents the assertShape function from throwing errors due to mismatched columns in the last empty row.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/ingest/parser.ts is affected as the parseStatement function there incorrectly handles a trailing blank line with columns but no data, causing a row shape error at the last empty row. Fixing it in this file by ignoring such blank rows after the last transaction resolves the issue.
